description: Prepare a dataset download and return a short-lived download capability, or enqueue a billed export when the requested GIS format needs conversion. An optional stateless filter (bbox, typed attribute predicates, column projection, row cap) produces a snapshot export; parquet filters are computed with DuckDB over the source GeoParquet. Repeat the same filter when polling status.
name: geobble_source_prepare_download
title: Prepare a source download
